fields.topology_type: Linear daisy-chained / party-line multipoint differential bus. Drivers, receivers and transceivers connect to a single main cable trunk via short network stubs.

supported_topologies.name: Half-duplex 2-wire daisy-chain
supported_topologies.description: Single twisted-pair trunk; nodes attached by short stubs; one driver active at a time. Used by Modbus RTU, DL/T645, BACnet MS/TP.

supported_topologies.name: Full-duplex 4-wire daisy-chain
supported_topologies.description: Two twisted-pair trunks: one master-to-slaves (Y/Z) and one slaves-to-master (A/B); no DE/RE# arbitration on master.

supported_topologies.name: Isolated multi-node
supported_topologies.description: All transceivers galvanically isolated except one which provides the single-ground reference (Figure 11-3 of SLLA272D).

supported_topologies.name: Standard 32-UL bus
supported_topologies.description: Up to 32 unit-load transceivers in the legacy default.

supported_topologies.name: Reduced-loading 256-node bus
supported_topologies.description: 1/8 UL transceivers + lightweight failsafe → up to 96 (with 20-UL failsafe overhead) or 256 (raw) nodes.

supported_topologies.name: Common-mode filtered bus
supported_topologies.description: Two 60-ohm series resistors + 220 pF to GND at each cable end; ≤ 1 % tolerance for matched roll-off.

master_slave_role_summary.description: A node that initiates communication; in half-duplex it polls slaves serially. In Modbus RTU there is typically one master and many slaves.
A node that responds to the master's polls; never speaks unprompted.
In token-passing protocols (BACnet MS/TP) any node may become temporary master while holding the token.
Receive-only node attached to the bus for diagnostic or logging; DE permanently LOW.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge defined by RS-485). Long buses can be extended via RS-485 repeaters or signal isolators (e.g. TI ISO35 family), each of which terminates and re-drives the bus on the other side.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_byte: LSB-first when UART framing is used.
ordering_guarantees.across_bytes: Strictly in transmitter-issue order; the bus is FIFO at the physical layer.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — RS-485 is electrical-only. Higher-level protocol register maps live in the SoC integration spec.

slave_classification.polled_target: Modbus RTU style — master polls each slave address; slave responds within a deadline.
slave_classification.interrupt_target: Slave Triggers polled by master scanning interrupt-status registers in upper protocol.
slave_classification.broadcast_target: Address 0 in Modbus RTU broadcasts to all slaves (no response).

Section 6 Bus Termination and Stub Length (Figure 6-1)

isolation_topology.low_GPD: Single shared ground via twisted-pair cable; works for benchtop / single-rack systems.
isolation_topology.moderate_GPD: Resistor-bonded ground separation (100-ohm bonding resistors); reduces loop current but residual noise sensitivity.
isolation_topology.high_GPD: Full galvanic isolation — digital isolator on data + isolated DC/DC on supply at each remote node; multi-kilovolt GPD tolerance.

fields.repeater_extension: Long RS-485 buses are partitioned by RS-485 repeaters that act as termination and active re-drivers; each repeater segment respects the standard 32-UL / 1200 m / stub-length budget independently.
